messages:
jamie (AE): Heads-up — customer Acme wants a short POC (30 days) with ~5M tokens. They asked for a temporary 30% off hosted rate and a conversion credit if they move to Dedicated. Can deal-desk approve?
deal-desk: Clarify the exact ask: list-price % off for the POC, and what form of conversion credit? cap? timeline?
jamie (AE): 30% off hosted API for the POC, capped at $10k. On conversion to a 12mo Dedicated commit, we’d apply 50% of the POC net spend as usable credit toward the commit. Need an exception approval so AE can offer this in the SOW.
olivia (finance): Need quick margin check — what model tier and token mix? Will the cap change math?
rafa (solutions): They’ll use rdx-3b-quant, token mix ~70% generation / 30% embeddings. Rough estimate: our cost delta ~22% for the POC profile, cap keeps gross exposure manageable.
lee (legal): No extra IP requirements from them, just standard NDA + POC SOW. Need conversion credit mechanics in contract language and an explicit expiration on credits.
deal-desk: We can approve a short-term promotional exception with conditions: 1) cap $10k must be enforced; 2) credit only applies if they sign within 60 days of POC end; 3) SOW must include conversion mechanics and ROI trigger; 4) require AE manager sign-off.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SR-5421 — ratecard-exception — assignee @deal-desk — priority: high.
jamie (AE): Copying a draft SOW snippet below for quick edit: ```scope: 30-day POC
po_amount: up to $10,000 (client liable for any overage)
discount: 30% off hosted rates during POC period
conversion_credit: 50% of POC net spend applied as credit toward a 12-month Dedicated commit if signed within 60 days after POC end
credit_expiry: credit expires 12 months from issuance
metrics_and_acceptance: documented acceptance criteria and ROI threshold included
```
olivia (finance): With the cap and 60-day sign window, finance conditionally ok. No retroactive credits beyond 60 days; credits cannot be refunded for cash.
deal-desk: Conditional approval granted. Please: 1) AE to update SOW with exact language; 2) attach POC playbook and expected token burn estimate; 3) get AE manager sign-off here. Once those are attached, deal-desk will mark SR-5421 approved. :white_check_mark:
jamie (AE): Will update SOW today and paste the final version in this thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
lee (legal): I’ll review the SOW language when posted, expect minor tweaks to conversion clause.
rafa (solutions): I’ll add the token/burn estimate and a short runbook for how we’ll instrument usage monitoring during the POC.
jamie (AE): FYI customer asked if this can be listed in the invoice description — yes, put "POC promotional credit" and we’ll track internally.
ops-bot: SR-5421 status: awaiting SOW attachment. Reminder set for 48h.
jamie (AE): SOW uploaded — see attached doc link (internal). AE mgr @morgan approved offline. Updating status now.
deal-desk: All checks passed. SR-5421 marked APPROVED. Please proceed with the POC offer and ensure finance codes are set. :tada:
